releases.title: The Architecture & System Rework
releases.short_title: A modular architecture, adaptive dashboard, and stronger security

updates.title: Adaptive Dashboard & Mini Landing Page
updates.description: When signed out on desktop, the dashboard transforms into an interactive landing page with inline login, live schedules, and lunch cards.

updates.title: System Theme Matching
updates.description: Gr0ve now automatically matches your operating system's light or dark mode across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android.

updates.title: Passwordless Email Authentication
updates.description: Sign in using your BCA email and a one-time passcode delivered directly to your inbox.

updates.title: Complete Architecture Rework
updates.description: Replaced the monolithic dashboard with a modular, single-responsibility architecture, eliminating dead code and redundant dependencies.

updates.title: Web Compiler Optimization
updates.description: Removed cyclic imports and cleaned up authentication and home-view dependencies to prevent Dart Development Compiler module-loading issues and improve hot restarts.

updates.title: Hardened Data Security
updates.description: Sensitive data endpoints are no longer polled without an authenticated session. Signing out clears proxy tokens, memory caches, and navigation state.

updates.title: Refined Interface & New Branding
updates.description: Modernized buttons, inputs, dialogs, cards, and navigation with consistent styling across light and dark themes. Introduced a new minimalist logo without gradients.
